actions_or_findings.title: STAFF-001 CURRENT_TASK_BLOCKER — Employee becomes unreachable after the last assignment ends
actions_or_findings.trigger: A manager ends an employee’s only effective property assignment.
actions_or_findings.rationale: The list excludes that employee, and the page has no lookup or reassignment route for a record no longer listed. The retained flow ends employee 9’s assignment through the page and then waits for employee 9 to disappear. The service API can assign a known employee ID, but the page cannot recover that ID for later maintenance.

actions_or_findings.title: STAFF-002 CURRENT_TASK_BLOCKER — Roster and duty state stop at 50 rows
actions_or_findings.trigger: A property has more than 50 current employees or daily status rows.
actions_or_findings.rationale: Both page requests fetch one default-sized page and ignore the returned cursor. Later employees cannot be listed or managed; their duty and load state may also be absent. The four-person evidence run does not exercise this boundary.

actions_or_findings.title: STAFF-EVID-003 CURRENT_TASK_BLOCKER — Existing-record maintenance lacks page evidence
actions_or_findings.trigger: Assessing department, capacity, duty, skill, and added service-property maintenance.
actions_or_findings.rationale: The retained request trace has no employee PATCH or property-assignment POST, and the automation flow does not perform those actions. Its create check confirms the employee number but does not read back every claimed field. The manager-list screenshot timed out. The current evidence therefore cannot establish that the full maintenance condition works through the page.

actions_or_findings.title: STAFF-REL-004 RELEASE_BLOCKER — Real model validation remains open
actions_or_findings.rationale: The persisted AI call is explicitly DEVELOPMENT with model version dev-llm-v1. This supports the local automatic-dispatch slice but does not validate self-hosted Qwen or real Embedding/RAG.
